requirements.requirement: The system must parse a valid last_update_date string into a standardized date format.
The system must calculate days_since_update as the difference in days between the current system date and the parsed last_update_date.
The system must assign a higher normalized_recency_score to trials with fewer days_since_update compared to those with more days_since_update.
The system must map days_since_update to a normalized_recency_score using predefined threshold ranges.
The system must ensure normalized_recency_score is bounded between 0 and 1 inclusive.
The system must compute normalized_recency_score deterministically such that identical inputs always produce the same score.
The system must set missing_data_flag to true when last_update_date is null or not provided.
The system must assign a default normalized_recency_score when last_update_date is missing.
The system must detect malformed last_update_date values and treat them as invalid inputs.
The system must set missing_data_flag to true and assign a default normalized_recency_score when last_update_date is malformed.
The system must handle future-dated last_update_date values by treating days_since_update as zero.
The system must produce days_since_update as a non-negative integer.
The system must return all computed fields (last_update_date, days_since_update, normalized_recency_score, missing_data_flag) in the output structure defined by the schema.
The system must execute recency scoring logic for each clinical trial record independently without cross-record interference.
